title: Travelling to Türkiye With Pets: Rules, Airlines & Pet-Friendly Stays
seoTitle: Travelling to Türkiye With Pets: Rules, Airlines & Stays
metaDescription: Navigate Türkiye's microchip, rabies titration and vet certificate rules, Turkish Airlines vs domestic pet policies, boutique hotels and EU/UK return.
quickAnswer: You can bring up to two cats or dogs into Türkiye with an ISO microchip, valid rabies vaccination, rabies antibody titration test (0.5 IU/ml or higher) and an official veterinary health certificate. Plan four months ahead if you are returning to the EU or UK, because Türkiye is an unlisted country requiring pre-travel rabies blood testing.

body.text: What microchip, rabies titration and vet certificate rules apply for entering Türkiye?

To enter Türkiye with a cat or dog, your pet needs an ISO-compliant 15-digit microchip implanted before its rabies vaccination, a valid rabies shot given at least 30 days prior, a rabies antibody titration test showing at least 0.5 IU/ml from an accredited laboratory, and an official government-endorsed veterinary health certificate.

Per guidance from the [Consulate General of Türkiye in Los Angeles](https://losangeles-cg.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowInfoNote/410171) and [New York](https://newyork-cg.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowInfoNote/254102), the blood draw must occur at least 30 days after rabies vaccination, and the government-endorsed health certificate must be issued shortly before departure. Travellers may bring up to two pets non-commercially; restricted breeds including Pitbull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino and Fila Brasileiro are prohibited.
How do Turkish Airlines and domestic flights handle cabin vs hold pets?

Turkish Airlines and Pegasus Airlines both allow cats and dogs up to 8 kg combined weight (pet plus carrier) in the cabin, while heavier pets fly in the pressurised cargo hold on Turkish Airlines and Pegasus—but not on AJet, which discontinued hold (AVIH) pet transport for bookings made on or after 1 September 2025.

Reserve your pet slot immediately after ticketing, as cabin quotas fill fast. Under [Turkish Airlines' pet rules](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/any-questions/traveling-with-pets/), cabin carriers max out at 23 × 30 × 40 cm (8 kg) and hold crates at 75 × 75 × 125 cm (50 kg). [Pegasus Airlines](https://www.flypgs.com/en/travelling-with-pets) allows 32 × 32 × 50 cm cabin carriers via call-centre booking, while [AJet](https://ajet.com/en/corporate/rules-and-conditions/pet) permits cabin pets only. Brachycephalic breeds are barred from the hold.

body.text: Are boutique hotels in Istanbul and Bodrum pet-friendly?

Yes, a growing number of five-star and boutique hotels in Istanbul and Bodrum welcome dogs and cats, though almost every property enforces weight caps (commonly 8–10 kg), per-night or cleaning fees, and bans pets from indoor dining rooms and pool decks. Written confirmation at booking is essential.

In Istanbul, [The Peninsula Istanbul](https://guide.michelin.com/en/hotels-stays/istanbul/the-peninsula-istanbul-12990) allows pets on request with applicable fees, and [Park Hyatt Istanbul Maçka Palas](https://www.hyatt.com/park-hyatt/en-US/istph-park-hyatt-istanbul-macka-palas/policies) welcomes well-behaved dogs upon signing a pet agreement at check-in. In Bodrum, [The Bodrum EDITION](https://guide.michelin.com/en/hotels-stays/bodrum/the-bodrum-edition-13266) accepts pets with applicable charges and provides pet bowls and baskets on request. Always verify three details before committing:

items: Weight cap and fee: Confirm current nightly fees, cleaning charges and security deposits.
Room restrictions: Coastal resorts often limit pets to garden suites or villas.
Neighbourhood animals: Keep visiting dogs leashed around Istanbul and Bodrum's resident street cats and dogs.

body.text: What rules apply when returning to the EU or UK with your pet?

Returning to the EU or Great Britain from Türkiye is strict because both classify Türkiye as an unlisted third country for rabies. Your pet needs a rabies antibody titration test (0.5 IU/ml minimum) plus a three-month wait from the blood draw, unless tested before leaving Europe.

Under [European Commission rules](https://food.ec.europa.eu/animals/live-animal-movements/dogs-cats-and-ferrets/bringing-pet-eu-non-eu-country_en), taking the titration test at an EU-approved lab before departing Europe avoids the three-month wait on return. For Great Britain, [GOV.UK rules](https://www.gov.uk/bring-pet-to-great-britain) require the blood test, GB health certificate, dog tapeworm treatment 1 to 5 days pre-arrival, and entry via approved cargo or overland routes from France.

faq.q: How far in advance should I start pet paperwork for a trip to Türkiye?
faq.a: Start at least four to five months before travel if you plan to return to the EU or UK, so you can complete microchipping, rabies vaccination and the rabies titration blood test before leaving home.

faq.q: Can my dog fly in the cabin directly from Istanbul to London?
faq.a: No. Under UK border rules, pets cannot arrive in the cabin on commercial flights into Great Britain; they must travel via an approved cargo route or fly into an EU airport like Paris or Amsterdam and cross into the UK via Eurotunnel or an approved ferry.

faq.q: Do pets need an exit health certificate to leave Türkiye?
faq.a: Yes. Before departing Türkiye internationally, you must obtain an official export health certificate from the Provincial Directorate of Agriculture (İl Tarım ve Orman Müdürlüğü), usually within 48 hours of your flight.

faq.q: Are dogs allowed inside Turkish museums, mosques and historic sites?
faq.a: No. Companion pets are not permitted inside mosques, palaces, museums or archaeological sites such as Ephesus, so arrange a vetted pet sitter or hotel care on sightseeing days.

faq.q: Can I take my dog on Istanbul ferries or private transfers?
faq.a: Public Şehir Hatları ferries permit muzzled leashed dogs or pets in carriers on outdoor decks, while private chauffeur-driven vehicles arranged in advance offer the cleanest, stress-free option for airport and coastal transfers.

faq.q: Are pet-friendly restaurants common in Istanbul and Bodrum?
faq.a: Outdoor terraces in neighbourhoods like Cihangir, Bebek, Kadıköy and Bodrum's marinas are generally welcoming to leashed, well-behaved dogs, though indoor dining rooms usually prohibit pets.
